summary: AES Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 confirming that on September 17, 2026, the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio approved its previously announced March 1, 2026 merger with Horizon Parent, L.P. and Horizon Merger Sub, Inc., which will merge into AES with AES surviving. Closing remains subject to additional regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Upon close, AES will be jointly owned by Global Infrastructure Management, LLC-affiliated vehicles and the EQT Infrastructure VI fund plus other investors. No price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed in this excerpt; this is a regulatory milestone update, and the deal-breaker to watch is remaining state and federal approvals.
